population.span: Among the 17 802 participants randomly assigned with low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol levels less than 3.37 mmol/L (<130 mg/dL) and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein levels of 2.0 mg/L or more without cardiovascular disease, 5695 were 70 years or older.

endpoint.span: The primary end point was the occurrence of a first cardiovascular event (myocardial infarction, stroke, arterial revascularization, hospitalization for unstable angina, or death from cardiovascular causes).

estimate.span: The rates of the primary end point in this age group were 1.22 and 1.99 per 100 person-years of follow-up in the rosuvastatin and placebo groups, respectively (hazard ratio, 0.61 [95% CI, 0.46 to 0.82]; P < 0.001).

ci.span: The rates of the primary end point in this age group were 1.22 and 1.99 per 100 person-years of follow-up in the rosuvastatin and placebo groups, respectively (hazard ratio, 0.61 [95% CI, 0.46 to 0.82]; P < 0.001).

treatment_strategy.span: Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive 20 mg of rosuvastatin daily or placebo.

absent_reason.analysis_set: The abstract identifies the age subgroup but does not explicitly state its analysis set. Registry intention-to-treat statements accompany whole-trial estimates, not the bound subgroup HR.
absent_reason.follow_up: No duration or explicit estimate timepoint is stated for the subgroup HR. The registry reports up to 5 years for whole-trial outcomes; applicability to this subgroup estimate is not explicitly stated.

served_mismatch: The served HR and confidence interval match the older-adult primary-endpoint estimate. However, the question and served analysis_set describe a pre-specified subgroup, whereas the abstract explicitly says the age cut-point was chosen after trial completion. Subgroup ITT status is not explicitly established. The source reports HR, not the RR named in served_outcome.estimand.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled younger adults as well as adults aged 70 or older without cardiovascular disease; the reported older-adult subgroup fits the question's age criterion.

notes: All bound spans use the complete abstract. The registry's whole-trial primary-endpoint HR of 0.56 is a different population estimate.
